caption: The drawing depicts a hand-cranked coffee grinder mounted on a wooden block. The grinder features a metallic body with a funnel-shaped top that has an open lid and a round emblem on the front. The metal parts are rendered in shades of brown and dark gray, showing signs of wear. The handle, which is attached to the side of the grinder, is curved and made of metal with a wooden knob at the end. The wooden block to which the grinder is attached appears textured with visible wood grain and is depicted in a natural tan color. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color with no additional objects or elements present. The artist's name, "Leroy M. Griffith," is written at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Wall Hopper
